_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil at score 50 with neutral tape favors holding the Complacency rung until F&G or flows print a clean break rather than forcing a directional rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split: analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on phase but inflow data does not contradict a hold-coil
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 45-55 and BTC stays range-bound with 30d change near flat and funding neutral
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below 40 with exchange inflows and long liquidations (down to Anxiety) or F&G >60 with ETF flows turning positive (up to Disbelief)
